********************************************************************************
DGL version history
********************************************************************************

This table lists previous versions of the ROCm DGL Docker image for
installation and testing. For detailed information about available models, 
see the version-specific documentation. You can find tagged
previous releases of the ``ROCm/dgl`` Docker image on `Docker Hub 
<https://hub.docker.com/r/rocm/dgl/tags>`__.
